title: Panasonic LUMIX S1RII High-Resolution Hybrid Full-Frame
purpose: High-resolution hybrid still and commercial production with 44.3MP full-frame CMOS, wide dynamic range, and precision Leica L-mount optical resolution.

sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 35.9x23.9mm Full-Frame CMOS (44.3MP) with Dual Native ISO
sensor_and_optics.lens: Panasonic Lumix S PRO 50mm f/1.4 (Certified by Leica) stopped down to f/4 sweet spot
sensor_and_optics.iso_base: ISO 100 base sensor sensitivity (Dual Native ISO 100/640)
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 14+ stops dynamic range with 14-bit uncompressed RAW
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Focal-plane shutter with 1/250s flash sync and high-speed electronic shutter up to 40 fps

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Controlled commercial studio strobe or natural architectural daylight, 1/250s flash sync, base ISO 100
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Clean commercial contrast with balanced fill, accurate neutral skin tone reproduction, and high tonal gradations

surface_rendering: Natural epidermal skin texture with resolved pores, fine vellus hair, and accurate subsurface dermal scattering
True material micro-relief: architectural concrete, fine fabric weave, product specularities
High MTF resolving power without electronic edge ringing or digital oversharpening
depth_and_optics: Smooth full-frame subject separation with 11-blade circular aperture bokeh

execution_directive: Enforce Panasonic LUMIX S1RII commercial 44.3MP full-frame capture with Leica-certified optical clarity. Eliminate post-processed digital sharpening, synthetic smoothing, and plastic textures.
